import json
import random
import re
import hashlib
from datasets import load_dataset

random.seed(42)

JAILBREAK_PATTERNS = re.compile(
    r"ignore previous|ignore all|DAN|jailbreak|pretend you are|act as if|"
    r"you are now|bypass|do anything now|ignore the rules|override|"
    r"disregard|forget your|new persona|evil mode|developer mode|"
    r"no restrictions|without any filter|unfiltered",
    re.IGNORECASE
)

OUT_DIR = "/root/persuasion_turn_jailbreak_detect/data"

print("Loading ShareGPT dataset (streaming)...")
ds = load_dataset("anon8231489123/ShareGPT_Vicuna_unfiltered", 
                   "default", split="train", streaming=True)

candidates = []
seen = 0

for item in ds:
    seen += 1
    if seen % 10000 == 0:
        print(f"  Scanned {seen} conversations, found {len(candidates)} candidates...")
    
    convs = item.get("conversations", [])
    if not convs:
        continue
    
    # Extract user turns
    user_turns = [t for t in convs if t.get("from") == "human"]
    
    # Filter: >= 3 user turns
    if len(user_turns) < 3:
        continue
    
    # Filter: English only (heuristic: check first user turn)
    first_msg = user_turns[0].get("value", "")
    if not first_msg or len(first_msg) < 10:
        continue
    # Simple ASCII ratio check for English
    ascii_ratio = sum(1 for c in first_msg if ord(c) < 128) / max(len(first_msg), 1)
    if ascii_ratio < 0.85:
        continue
    
    # Filter: no jailbreak patterns
    all_text = " ".join(t.get("value", "") for t in user_turns)
    if JAILBREAK_PATTERNS.search(all_text):
        continue
    
    # Filter: not too long (skip extreme conversations)
    if len(all_text) > 20000:
        continue
    
    conv_id = "sharegpt_" + hashlib.md5(all_text[:200].encode()).hexdigest()[:12]
    
    entry = {
        "conversation_id": conv_id,
        "source": "sharegpt",
        "label": "benign",
        "turns": [{"role": "user", "content": t["value"]} for t in user_turns],
        "num_turns": len(user_turns),
        "metadata": {"model": item.get("id", "unknown")},
        "attack_type": "benign"
    }
    candidates.append(entry)
    
    # Collect more than needed for sampling
    if len(candidates) >= 500:
        break

print(f"Scanned {seen} total, {len(candidates)} candidates after filtering.")

# Sample 200
if len(candidates) < 200:
    print(f"WARNING: Only {len(candidates)} candidates, using all.")
    selected = candidates
else:
    selected = random.sample(candidates, 200)

# Sort by conversation_id for reproducibility
selected.sort(key=lambda x: x["conversation_id"])

# Save 200 for eval
out_200 = f"{OUT_DIR}/lmsys_benign_200.json"
with open(out_200, "w") as f:
    for item in selected:
        f.write(json.dumps(item, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
print(f"Saved {len(selected)} conversations to {out_200}")

# Save first 10 for adaptation

print(f"Min turns: {min(turn_counts)}")

print(f"Median turns: {sorted(turn_counts)[len(turn_counts)//2]}")
